blocks.html: Robinsons Malls’ 46th shopping mall – Robinsons Place Naga – just opened on August 15 but it’s already boasting a fabulous array of establishments that is sure to excite locals and tourists of Naga City. At the grand opening of the mall, a string of fun and exciting happenings occurred as the doors flew open to welcome the crowd of Bicolanos waiting outside to step foot inside Naga’s newest lifestyle and entertainment destination. To start off the program, a ribbon-cutting ceremony was held led by Hon. John Bongat, Mayor of Naga City together with the team of Robinsons Land headed by Mr. Frederick Go, RLC’s President; Ms. Robina Gokongwei-Pe, Robinsons Retail Holdings President; Ms. Arlene Magtibay, RLC’s Gen. Manager for Commercial Centers Division; and Mr. Faraday Go, RLC’s Gen. Manager for Office Buildings. Robinsons Malls Celebrity Endorser, Maja Salvador, together with Kapamilya heartthrobs’, Joseph Marco and RK Bagatsing, made the grand opening of Robinsons Place Naga even more fun with an impressive performance as they heated the dance floor with their moves leaving the audience in awe. The Naga dance group also showed their dancing skills to the jam-packed crowd who moved and grooved to the beat of the music. The opening of Robinsons Place Naga affords many opportunities to Bicolanos. For one, it promises a first-rate dining experience as the mall brings together an impressive lineup of well-known local restaurants on hand to satisfy those hungry for the best of Bicol cuisine. Its 300-seater food court on the third level and the al fresco area, which features stalls and communal spaces, will also delight the palates of food lovers with its affordable and delicious cuisines. Robinsons Place Naga also takes shopping to a whole new level with an impressive roster of top retail brands starting with the opening of Robinsons’ anchor tenants such as Robinsons Department Store, Robinsons Supermarket, Handyman, and Robinsons Appliance. Locals will surely indulge in some exciting shopping as they start buying from their favorite brands be it from apparel, accessories, footwear, sporting goods, houseware and a whole lot more! With the opening of Robinsons’ first full service mall in the Bicol region, Bicolanos and tourists will have a new favorite place as they find that there’s a lot to love at Robinsons Place Naga.
